question: Alum is made by dissolving bauxite in:
solution:
The correct answer is__** sulphuric acid.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• A more usual production procedure is to treat bauxite ore with** sulfuric acid and then with potassium sulfate.**
 
• Ammonium alum
